title: Direct trade-action path: review trigger -> review lane -> mandate-approved action executes on the account immediately (no repo/PR/Actions hop); operator-needed actions get a one-tap Approve button that executes directly
note: Operator 2026-11-12 ~00:00Z, verbatim: 'those decisions shouldn't, preferably not even going through the repo, like there might be logged there, but the action needs to be, it doesn't need a PR, that can't be the flow here. We need something that's much more direct so that actions can be taken while they're relevant, otherwise the whole, this whole thing is completely pointless, right? We need to have like the alerts, when the system recognizes that a review is needed, the review needs to start immediately, it needs to get pushed to the review lane, and when the review makes a decision that is approved by a mandate, then that decision needs to be implemented on the account immediately, not through the repo. And if it needs me, then it needs to ping me so that I can immediately do that, right? But also through the system, not like going into the broker account. So there needs to be a button that I press to accept a recommendation, and that directly executes that action.' Trigger: 2026-11-11 the ETH and SOL ml_entry close recommendations (+0.36R / +0.35R measured) sat in the GitHub-issue / Actions-queue path until the stops hit (ETH lost ~0.37R more).
